newsitem.title: UK: UK stamp duty relief for mutual insurer transfers.
newsitem.headline: UK stamp duty relief for mutual insurer transfers.

text.p: UK chancellor Kenneth Clarke is to introduce stamp duty relief for the transfer of an insurance business by a mutual company to a conventional company. This will apply if at least 90 percent of the members are offered shares in the new company, the Inland Revenue said. The necessary legislation will be included in the Finance Bill. It also said that a temporary stamp duty exemption for mergers between unit trusts, and mergers of unit trusts into open-ended investment companies, is to run until June 30 1999.
In addition, the government wants to simplify the stamp duty regime for repurchases of units by unit trust managers.
